items.quote: I'm already dealing with someone from your company.
items.statement: A common objection is already dealing with someone from the same company.

items.quote: are you hundred percent satisfied with the information and service or support.
items.statement: In response to objections, ask if the client is 100% satisfied with their current relationship.

items.quote: no one is hundred percent satisfied with that, literally anything that's just a human being.
items.statement: No one is 100% satisfied with service from others, indicating room for improvement.

items.quote: would that be useful if maybe we're going to jump on a quick call or online Zoom meeting.
items.statement: Proposing a quick call or online meeting to refresh information and share key selling points.

overview: An interaction discussing sales objections and engagement strategies in the context of real estate.
